desc: Terminal-grade AI coding assistant powered by DeepSeek (VS Code extension entry). Reuses the core agent engine; feature-identical with the CLI.
config.apiKey: DeepSeek API key. **Recommended: leave empty** and set the `DEEP_SEEK_API_KEY` environment variable instead (the key never lands in settings.json and never travels with machine sync). When empty, the variable is read as a fallback. This setting's scope is `machine`, so Settings Sync never uploads it.
config.model: Default model (e.g. deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro). Empty falls back to the DEEP_SEEK_MODEL env var, then deepseek-flash.
config.models: Candidate list for the model picker: when non-empty it replaces the built-ins (deepseek-flash / deepseek-v4-pro / deepseek-flash-vision-exp — the picker shows exactly what you configure); empty uses the built-ins. Takes effect immediately, no restart.
config.locale: UI / reply language. Empty asks on first run.
config.apiUrl: DeepSeek-compatible API endpoint. Empty falls back to the DEEP_SEEK_API_URL env var, then https://api.deepseek.com.
config.auxModel: Auxiliary model (lightweight tasks such as summarization). Empty falls back to DEEP_SEEK_AUX_MODEL, then deepseek-flash.
config.reasoningEffort: Reasoning effort. Empty falls back to DEEP_SEEK_REASONING_EFFORT, then high. (low/medium deprecated)
config.thinking: Deep-thinking switch. On by default; pick off to disable (equivalent to DEEP_SEEK_THINKING=0).
config.parallelSafeTools: Run SAFE read-only tools concurrently within a round (write tools / approvals / terminal / background tools stay serial). On by default; off restores full serial execution.
config.workflowConcurrency: Concurrency cap for run_workflow subagents. Empty(0) falls back to DEEP_SEEK_WORKFLOW_CONCURRENCY, default 4.
config.workflowMaxSteps: Max steps per run_workflow invocation. Empty(0) falls back to DEEP_SEEK_WORKFLOW_MAX_STEPS, default 8.
config.streamIdleTimeoutMs: Streaming idle timeout (ms). Empty(0) falls back to DEEP_SEEK_STREAM_IDLE_TIMEOUT_MS, default 120000.
config.openBeside: Open the chat panel beside the active editor (ViewColumn.Beside). Off opens it in the first column.
